projects.name: fir_stream_accelerator
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog with SystemVerilog testbench and immediate assertions
projects.summary: Parameterized transposed-form FIR accelerator: 8 MAC/cycle, ~1 sample/clock, 7.88x over a scalar baseline; 1354-sample differential test, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: systolic_gemm_accelerator
projects.interface: Wishbone B4 classic bus with memory-mapped operand/result windows and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: C firmware driver with tiled-GEMM host application
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: Parameterized 8x8 INT8 output-stationary systolic GEMM tile engine with K-accumulate tiling: up to 64 MAC/cycle, 49.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 273 jobs / 17152 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: scan_prefix_sum_engine
projects.microarchitecture: parallel-prefix (Kogge-Stone) adder tree with cross-tile carry chaining
projects.interface: APB control plane plus descriptor-driven coalesced wide-DMA master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style parallel prefix-sum (scan) engine: 16-lane parallel-prefix tree streams one coalesced 512-bit beat/clock, 15.06 sustained words/cycle (16.0 ideal), 45.18x aggregate / 46.88x peak over a scalar baseline; 292 jobs / 257960 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: bitonic_sort_accelerator
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined Batcher bitonic sorting network (compare-exchange lane array)
projects.interface: MMIO register file plus a coalesced wide-DMA memory master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style tiled bitonic sort engine: 10-stage / 80-cell compare-exchange network retires one 16-key (512-bit) tile per clock, 13.18 sustained keys/cycle (16.0 ideal), 105.43x aggregate / 116.20x peak over a scalar baseline; 286 jobs / 275984 checked keys, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_texture_filter_engine
projects.microarchitecture: line-buffer window with 2x2 texel gather and a fixed-point bilinear blend datapath
projects.interface: mailbox + doorbell registers with completion interrupt plus a coalesced wide memory master
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style bilinear texture-filter (image resampler): a two-row line-buffer window feeds a 2x2 texel gather and a Q16.16 bilinear blend datapath that retires one filtered pixel per clock; 0.67 sustained / 0.97 peak pixels/cycle (1.0 ideal), 22.49x aggregate / 32.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 290 jobs / 314316 output pixels / 78579 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_philox_rng_engine
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined counter-based (Philox) multi-round datapath with parallel SIMD lanes
projects.interface: MMIO mailbox descriptor + doorbell with a coalesced wide masked write-only DMA master and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model, anchored to the published Random123 known-answer vectors
projects.summary: GPU-style Philox-4x32-10 counter-based parallel RNG: a 4-lane SIMD array of fully-pipelined 10-round Philox cores retires one 128-bit random block per lane per clock (512 random bits/clock), 3.40 sustained / 3.71 peak draws/cycle (4.0 ideal), 441.95x aggregate / 481.76x peak over a scalar baseline; 294 jobs / 276808 checked words, 0 mismatches.
